THERAILGUN2-CONDUIT.title: Conduit
THERAILGUN2-CONDUIT.description: If this card is discarded during the player's turn, immediately Channel 1 Lightning.
THERAILGUN2-GUARDBREAK.title: Guardbreak
THERAILGUN2-GUARDBREAK.description: Immediately before dealing any damage from this card, remove all Block from the damage's target.
THERAILGUN2-DISCHARGE.title: Discharge
THERAILGUN2-DISCHARGE.description: If this card is discarded or [gold]Exhausted[gold] during the player's turn, it immediately plays for free.
THERAILGUN2-SHORTED.title: Shorted
THERAILGUN2-SHORTED.description: This card will not be played when [gold]Exhausted[/gold] as an effect of [gold]Discharge[/gold]. Removed from cards at the end of your turn.
